plan_dependency_review.limits: Static source/consumer audit of current new modules, not a proof against arbitrary caller-provided data paths. Existing legacy interfaces outside P2 can still use PLAN.

legacy_exception.meaning: Real optional historical Phase0 report reader; unchanged in all three snapshots, not a new P2 runtime dependency.

conclusion.does_not_claim: Whole tree equivalence, new GPU pass, simulator error-path coverage, scientific benefit, or elimination of all historical PLAN readers.
